questions.question_english: According to Locke's Goal-Setting Theory, an incentive is most effective in enhancing performance when it is associated with goals that are:
options_english: Vague and easily achievable
Specific, measurable, and challenging yet attainable
Impossible to achieve, to push the limits
Kept secret from the teachers until the end of the year
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is (b). According to Locke’s Goal-Setting Theory, incentives are most effective when tied to goals that are specific, measurable, and challenging yet achievable. Clear targets direct attention and sustained effort far better than vague directives or simple tasks. Unattainable goals cause frustration and demotivation, while secret criteria prevent educators from aligning their instructional efforts with institutional expectations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। लॉक के लक्ष्य-निर्धारण सिद्धांत के अनुसार, प्रोत्साहन तब सबसे प्रभावी होते हैं जब वे विशिष्ट, मापने योग्य, और चुनौतीपूर्ण फिर भी प्राप्त करने योग्य लक्ष्यों से जुड़े होते हैं। स्पष्ट लक्ष्य ध्यान और निरंतर प्रयास को अस्पष्ट निर्देशों या सरल कार्यों की तुलना में बेहतर दिशा में निर्देशित करते हैं। प्राप्त करने में असंभव लक्ष्य निराशा और हतोत्साह उत्पन्न करते हैं, जबकि गुप्त मानदंड शिक्षकों को उनके शैक्षणिक प्रयासों को संस्थागत अपेक्षाओं के साथ संरेखित करने से रोकते हैं।

questions.question_english:
The 'Halo Effect' in teacher performance appraisal, which can disrupt the fair distribution
    of non-financial incentives like promotions, refers to:
options_english: Favorably rating all traits based on a single positive trait or impression
Rating a teacher negatively across all parameters due to a recent, single isolated mistake
Rating all evaluated teachers as average in order to avoid administrative interpersonal conflict
Relying almost entirely on direct unverified student feedback for formal performance evaluation
questions.explanation_english: The halo effect is a cognitive bias in performance evaluation where an evaluator’s general positive impression or single outstanding trait favorably influences ratings across all other unrelated performance parameters. In teacher appraisals, this bias distorts objective evaluation, leading to unfair distribution of non-financial incentives like awards or promotions, thereby damaging organizational justice and staff trust.

     primary purpose of incentives in a school
     organization.

Incentives are primarily designed to replace
         the basic compensation structure of teachers

Incentives are strictly used to compensate for
         poor working conditions within the school

Incentives aim to align the personal goals

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that incentives aim to align the personal goals of the teaching staff with the institutional goals of the school. The primary objective of an incentive system in educational management is to harmonize individual professional aspirations with broader institutional goals. When educators perceive that achieving school goals leads to personal and professional fulfillment, their motivation increases. Incentives do not replace basic salary structures or remedy poor working conditions; rather, they direct constructive efforts towards strategic objectives.

questions.question_english:
If a school administration implements a scheme
       where teachers receive a small cash reward for
     organizing extracurricular events, what is a
     potential negative exception to its success?

It may directly motivate teachers to
         regularly organize a much wider variety of

It may lead to teachers neglecting their core

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that it may lead to teachers neglecting their core academic duties in favor of rewarded events.        performance, the teacher must value the reward
       being offered. In motivational psychology, this
       value is known as:
options_english: Valence

Hygiene
Instrumentality
questions.explanation_english:

    the specific personal value or attractiveness
    an individual places on an offered outcome or

    recognition or financial compensation, that
    incentive carries high valence. Incentives fail
    to motivate if the outcome holds low personal
    value, regardless of how clearly performance
    expectations and administrative reward delivery
    are established.

questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। एक शिक्षक को हाउस मास्टर के रूप में नियुक्त करना नेतृत्व, आदर, और संगठनात्मक संबंध की मनोवैज्ञानिक आवश्यकताओं पर आधारित एक प्रोत्साहन प्रदान करता है। यह भूमिका सामाजिक जिम्मेदारी, सहकर्मी सम्मान, और स्कूल समुदाय में पर्यवेक्षी अधिकार प्रदान करती है। यह अंतर्निहित प्रेरक कारकों और सामाजिक मान्यता पर काम करती है, न कि वित्तीय मुआवजे, मूल शारीरिक आवश्यकताओं, या प्रशासनिक अनुशासनात्मक दंड के डर पर।
